title: mr-ses-cvd: code and derived results for a preregistered Mendelian randomization study of socioeconomic position and cardiovascular disease
description: Analysis code (R, Python), derived study-level results and the registered analysis plan for a preregistered two-sample Mendelian randomization study of socioeconomic measures and cardiovascular disease using public GWAS summary statistics. Source GWAS data are not redistributed. Registration: https://osf.io/k7dcm and https://osf.io/usz4x.
